runtime.note: signal-cli is compiled ahead of time into a single native executable, so the app ships no Java runtime and no jars. This also removes the JIT and unsigned-executable-memory entitlements a JVM requires.

graalvm.note: Oracle GraalVM for JDK 25. Only a build-time dependency; nothing from it ships in the app beyond compiled code.

note: Run Scripts/macOS/vendor-signal-cli.sh to populate Vendor/Artifacts. signal-cli is GPL-3.0; redistributing a combined Vela.app requires offering corresponding source for both projects.
